info.about: God Eater 2 is a video game developed by Shift and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment on November 14, 2013, in Japan for PlayStation Vita and PlayStation Portable. It is a sequel to God Eater.
info.trivia: The Vita version was sold in North America only as a download; the PS4 disc was the physical release.
info.why: No US Vita disc exists, so physical copies are European or Asian imports.
